about_the_game:
Floworlds is a relaxing single player strategic puzzle game where you carefully drop payloads to convert barren worlds to habitable worlds. Converting each world is a unique puzzle. Puzzles are organized into Systems where each System contains two Worlds:

  • A Moon (easier)

  • A Planet (harder)

You have been assigned a sector of 1,000,000 Systems to ensure a lifetime of puzzles.

For each World:

  • Carefully choose Payload placements to ensure the World is completely covered.

  • Payload Drops will Flow down paths from higher zones to lower. Longer Flow paths convert more than shorter paths.

  • Flow changes Barren zones to Bio-zones. The Bio-zones generate Growth needed to convert the World.

It should be possible to complete all worlds (verification of this statement pending the game authors completion of all Systems).

Relaxing Fun

  • No time limit.

  • Game state is saved on exit, so stop and resume at any time.

  • No restrictions or unlocking. Travel to any System at any time. Switch between Planet and Moon at any time.

  • Each puzzle is fairly short. Expect to convert a Moon during a coffee break, convert a Planet, or two, on a lunch break.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380. Vram: 6 GB.
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL compatible sound card
